_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for what counts as a brand in this repo.
Read by two consumers that must never disagree:
1. scripts/check_no_brands.py  - the pre-commit gate that keeps these names
out of every view, demo, dataset, doc and agent spec.
2. engine/region-source.ts     - the POI-selection filter that keeps a
brand-named third-party map POI out of generated demo data.
This file is the ONE place the strings are allowed to appear, and it is
allowlisted in the gate for exactly that reason. Duplicating the list into
TypeScript is what forced the gate to flag its own filter, so do not.
SCOPE. In: the customer and its programme names, freight exchanges and load
boards, and named carriers used as prospect lists - the things that leak into
demos and make a neutral solution look like it belongs to somebody. Out:
technical dependencies the solution genuinely uses (CARTO basemaps, Snowflake,
the H3 library) and third-party research citations in the blog drafts, where
naming a source is attribution rather than branding.
acronyms are matched CASE-SENSITIVELY. Case-insensitive matching on a
three-letter acronym is worse than no check: it fires on 'follow-ups' and on
the d3-dsv dependency, and a gate with false positives teaches people to
ignore it.
poi_exclude is deliberately a SHORTER list than names. It filters real
third-party place names, and the dataset is full of legitimate shops and fuel
stations whose names are factual; scrubbing every commercial name would gut
the realism the demo depends on while fixing nothing anyone objected to.
